scripts.build: npm run build:standard && npm run build:inline
scripts.build:standard: esbuild src/worker.mjs --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --external:cloudflare:sockets --banner:js="// Single-file Worker. cloudflare:sockets is built into Cloudflare; no additional files are required." --outfile=worker.js
scripts.build:inline: esbuild src/worker-inline.mjs --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --banner:js="// Standalone Worker. Uses request.fetcher.connect from workerd for TCP." --outfile=../源码.js
scripts.test:runtime: node tests/runtime.mjs && node tests/tcp-runtime.mjs && INLINE_WORKER=1 node tests/runtime.mjs && INLINE_WORKER=1 node tests/tcp-runtime.mjs
